note: Wide, calm beach protected by the breakwater. The bike and pedestrian path runs the full length toward Belmont Shore.

note: About 3 miles of car-free path from Shoreline Village to Belmont Shore. Separate lanes for bikes and walkers.

Boardwalk, harbor cruises and the Aquarium of the Pacific just beyond. Reachable by the beach path or the Passport shuttle.
